== Title ==
<span lang="ja">帝国軍補給物資</span>. One asterisk precedes the printed title.

== Card Text ==
<span lang="ja">ユーズド：1フォース失って2フォース起動する。ロスト：1フォース失って4フォース起動する。</span>

== Lore ==
<span lang="ja">帝国は恐怖を原動力として軍事物資を効率的に供給する。紛争が起こる地域に次々と武器や装備を移し替え、戦術的に重要な拠点に物資を最大限に集中させるのだ。</span>

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Imperial Supply.

'''Lore''' — The Empire uses fear as a driving force to supply military goods efficiently. It shifts weapons and equipment to conflict regions and concentrates supplies on tactically important bases.

'''Game text''' — USED: Lose 1 Force to activate 2 Force. LOST: Lose 1 Force to activate 4 Force.

One asterisk precedes the title. Used and Lost numbers match the English face. Activate is 起動する. Lore names 恐怖 as the driving force and 戦術的に重要な拠点.<ref>[[:File:Hoth-D-imperialsupply.gif|Original English face]], [[Imperial Supply]].</ref>
